english_translation: My head is aching severely during my pregnancy and is not getting better; what medicine can I safely take?
grammar_notes: Concordial Agreement (Zvivakashure): Notice how 'ndingadawo' establishes the noun class/subject frame (Mupanda 5/9 Nominal or Verbal Stem).
Agglutinative Morphology: 'ndakazvitakura' combines prefixal/suffixal morphemes (ndi- (1sg subj) + -ka- (remote past) + -zvitakura (stem)) with tone contour H-L-H-L.
Penultimate Lengthening: In Zezuru declarative sentences, the second-to-last syllable of the phrase carries natural vowel lengthening.
cultural_notes: In Harare Zezuru standard speech, speakers maintain strict alliterative concord (zvivakashure) across noun classes while using respectful plural forms (hunhu).
